title: Two massive stars may be secretly feeding the Milky Way’s supermassive black hole
caption:
Astronomers have traced mysterious gas clouds at the center of the Milky Way to a pair of massive stars orbiting in a tight dance. These stars collide their winds to create dense clumps that may sustain the activity of our supermassive black hole.

Source: Sciencedaily - Two massive stars may be secretly feeding the Milky Way’s supermassive black hole

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261119194605.htm
